# Cyprus Orthopaedics

> Orthopaedics and trauma clinic at Dr. Suat Günsel Kyrenia University Hospital (Girne, North Cyprus), run by the University of Kyrenia Faculty of Medicine Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology. Pages in Turkish and English.

## Clinic
- [Home (TR)](https://www.cyprusorthopaedics.com/tr): what we treat, doctors, how a visit works, contact
- [Home (EN)](https://www.cyprusorthopaedics.com/en)

## Doctors
- [Fazlı Levent Umur](https://www.cyprusorthopaedics.com/en/doctors/fazli-levent-umur)
- [Enes Sarı](https://www.cyprusorthopaedics.com/en/doctors/enes-sari)
- [Utku Gürhan](https://www.cyprusorthopaedics.com/en/doctors/utku-gurhan)

## Treatment areas
- Shoulder and elbow, hand and wrist, hip, knee, foot and ankle, fractures and trauma, children's orthopaedics, bone and soft tissue tumours (spinal surgery is not offered here)

## Patient guide
- [Patient guide index (EN)](https://www.cyprusorthopaedics.com/en/blog): sourced patient articles, each listing its references
- [Hasta rehberi (TR)](https://www.cyprusorthopaedics.com/tr/blog)
